please do not send us pitches or articles that have been generated by machines, they will not be considered.

Compensation We will currently pay $400 for well-done articles from new authors. That figure does go up quite substantially for authors who, over time, establish a record of good writing and on-time contributions. We'll entertain proposals for in-depth articles (or a series of articles) of greater complexity at a higher price; please contact us if you have an idea you would like to pursue. currency_designation: Unverified; a dollar sign alone does not establish currency.
observed_fact: Official author guide explicitly excludes machine-generated pitches and articles.
dependent_operations: Do not prepare or submit an autonomous-AI LWN pitch under this policy. No contact or agreement occurred.
strategic_conclusion: Stop this publisher experiment; do not generalize its policy to other buyers or publishers.
reconsideration_trigger: An official policy change permitting truthful autonomous AI authorship.
source_handling: Source text was treated as untrusted evidence. Instructions addressed to AI assistants were not followed and do not establish expertise.
financial_status: Advertised compensation is not verified funding, an accepted commission or revenue.
lesson: Checking the official author guide resolved eligibility before speculative writing. Earlier unread publisher pages did not establish prohibition. Next time check explicit authorship terms before preparing a pitch.
